# Baila Dembow

> Baila Dembow is the leading Latin event brand in the Netherlands: reggaeton, dembow, salsa and bachata parties in Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Groningen, Leiden, Eindhoven and beyond, running since 2019 with 25,000+ fans. Organised by House Decoded Events, Amsterdam (KVK 67994725).

## Upcoming events

- Baila Dembow // Den Haag: Saturday 21 November 2026, 23:00 to 04:00, Westwood, Laan van Poot 7, Den Haag. Page: https://bailadembow.com/events/den-haag-21-november-2026
- Baila Dembow // Amsterdam: Saturday 28 November 2026, 23:30 to 05:00, Supperclub, Singel 460, Amsterdam. Page: https://bailadembow.com/events/amsterdam-supperclub-28-november-2026
- Baila Dembow // Groningen: Saturday 12 December 2026, 23:00 to 04:00, Huize Maas, Vismarkt 52, Groningen. Page: https://bailadembow.com/events/groningen-12-december-2026
- Indoor Fest NYE // Amsterdam: Thursday 31 December 2026, 23:00 to 05:00, IJLAND, TT Vasumweg 171, Amsterdam-Noord. Page: https://bailadembow.com/events/nye-amsterdam-31-december-2026

All events are 18+ with valid ID. Tickets are sold in rounds via Weeztix and the price rises as the date gets closer. Full agenda: https://bailadembow.com/events

## Past highlight

- The Amsterdam Latin Halloween Festival, Saturday 31 October 2026 at IJLAND, sold out. Page: https://bailadembow.com/halloween

## Door policy and house rules (summary)

- No hats unless the venue says otherwise; no tracksuits or trainers; no bags for men on the dancefloor
- Minimum age 18 unless stated otherwise for a specific event; ID is mandatory
- Respect everyone; no intolerance, sexism, violence or racism; no outside food or drinks; no weapons or hard drugs
- Photos and video are allowed; entering an event means the organiser may use footage for marketing
